summary: Backend-only testing of WhyMob CRM Resend integration (SDK-based refactor). All 13 pytest cases passed: test-email happy path returns email_id from Resend, RBAC (no-auth 401/403, comercial 403), payload validation 422, digest returns sent:false when no alerts and sent:true with email_id when a 'ganha' proposal is force-seeded via Mongo. Regression sanity on login, /leads, /opportunities, /orders, /dashboard/alerts, /analytics/executive all 200.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1766 lines — should be split into routers (auth, leads, opportunities, orders, notifications, analytics) for maintainability.
send_alerts_digest signature is `payload: dict = None` — replace with a Pydantic model (e.g. AlertsDigestRequest{to: Optional[EmailStr]}) for validation and OpenAPI docs.
Review request referenced `/api/dashboard/executive` but the actual route is `/api/analytics/executive` — worth aligning naming or documenting.
_send_resend_email surfaces raw exception message in HTTP 500 body (`f"Resend erro: {str(e)}"`) — consider redacting to avoid leaking Resend internals to clients.
SENDER_EMAIL fallback defaults to `onboarding@resend.dev` if envs missing — fine for sandbox, but should fail loudly in production.
seed_data_creation: For the forced-alert digest test, a proposal doc with id prefix `TEST_prop_` and `_test_marker: resend_digest_pytest` is inserted into `proposals` collection and deleted in the same test's finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_notifications_resend.py covers Resend + regression sanity. It force-inserts a proposal into Mongo (via MONGO_URL/DB_NAME) to trigger a real alert. If Mongo credentials change or the `proposals` schema evolves, update the forced doc. Use `delivered@resend.dev` for Resend sandbox — never a real address in CI.
rca of the issue: n/a — no bugs found. One initial test failure (`/dashboard/executive` 404) was a test-side path mistake (actual route is `/analytics/executive`); fixed in test file.
